name: Depth's Revival 2
source:
You wake up one day and lose everything you ever had. What will you do? Keep fighting? I'm afraid I'm not that strong. I chose the easy way out, and if you can believe that, I even botched that one. Now I have a hot babe inside my head saying she can fix my life.
